newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro-MPs approve new combined transport scheme.
newsitem.headline: Euro-MPs approve new combined transport scheme.

text.p: The European Parliament on Thursday approved at first reading plans to grant European Union funding for combined transport schemes to cut the number of goods lorries on European roads and reduce pollution.
Between 1992 and 1996 the EU granted 22.7 million ecus to 16 pilot projects pooling road, rail and water transport.

Parliament adopted a report by German Socialist Ulrich Stockman approving a draft regulation extending the programme for a further six years -- COM(96)335 -- but said the 35- million-ecu budget proposed by the European Commission was too small to build up a proper network of combined transport routes.
Euro-MPs also asked the Commission to pay more attention to links with central and eastern Europe.
